Water butt rebates

Who can apply

Plot holders who fit a rain barrel this season can claim part of its cost back from the association. Keep the receipt and fill in the short form at the gate hut before the end of August.

How much

Half of the price you paid, up to thirty pounds for each plot. The treasurer pays the claims at the end of the month, in the order they were handed in, and writes to you if something is missing from the form.

Marsh Lane Allotments, 4 Marsh Lane. Open from dawn to dusk.
